description: This file implements logging utilities for PyTorch's distributed package, including logger creation, message formatting, and decorators for exception and timing logging.

methods.name: _get_or_create_logger
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a logger configured with a specific handler and formatter.

methods.name: _get_logging_handler
methods.description: Retrieves a logging handler and its name based on the destination.

methods.name: _get_msg_dict
methods.description: Constructs a message dictionary with distributed process info for logging.

methods.name: _exception_logger
methods.description: Decorator that wraps a function to log exceptions with context.

methods.name: _time_logger
methods.description: Decorator that logs the execution time of a function.
